name: 唇部同步分析
description: 检测视频中唇部运动与音频之间的不匹配以识别深度伪造篡改。
useCase: 检测换脸或唇部同步的深度伪造视频
mechanism: Extracts lip region from video frames and analyzes the correlation between lip movements and corresponding audio phonemes. AI生成的 face swaps often fail to perfectly synchronize lip movements with speech, creating detectable temporal mismatches.
accuracy: 高 - 80-90%（含音频的深度伪造视频）
source: Haliassos et al. (2021) - Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach to Face Forgery Detection, CVPR
algorithm: 唇部区域提取 + 音视频相关 + 音素对齐
parameters: 面部检测: MTCNN, 唇部ROI: 48-68特征点, 音频特征: MFCC, 相关窗口: 200ms
strengths:
• 对检测唇部同步深度伪造非常有效
• 利用音视频相关作为强信号
• 对仅视觉篡改具有鲁棒性
• 即使在低分辨率视频上也能工作
limitations:
• 需要带音轨的视频
• 仅检测面部相关的篡改
• 多个说话者时性能下降
• 对静音或纯音乐视频效果较差

references.title: Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach to Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Agarwal, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Phoneme-Viseme Mismatches. CVPR Workshop.
Zhou, Y. et al. (2021). Joint Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection. ICCV.
